native_memory_diagnostic.purpose: Diagnostic only: 8 consecutive 20-step episodes (hold policy) to separate per-reset from per-step memory growth
native_memory_diagnostic.finding: Host RSS grows about 82 MiB per Native reset with no plateau over 8 resets while process GPU memory stays flat; the growth is per reset of the Native runtime (isaac_sim_runner reset rebuilds the stage, cameras and material), not per control step and not in the wrapper (kinematic: 1.9 MiB/episode). Not fixed here (isaac_sim_runner is outside this task's scope).

The per-step collision check covers blade/handle vs declared fixtures and table only; robot links/cameras are covered by the C2 preflight for planned paths and action programs, not for arbitrary online actions.
Native PRE_CUT measured-path clearance (47.5 um in the deliberately stopped episode) is the known C5 issue (C5b path_v3).
Isaac Lab with the preset: NOT_RUN; Native REJECTED_IK_UNREACHABLE / joint actions: covered by code path and CPU tests with the kinematic backend only (no Native episode triggered them).
